name: System Party Modification 3 Choice
definition: Identifies which information are involved by a modification request for party reference data.

SystemPartyDate.name: System Party Date
SystemPartyDate.definition: Specifies the opening and closing dates, as assigned by the system.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the party within the system.

PartyName.name: Party Name
PartyName.definition: Specifies the name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

ContactDetails.name: Contact Details
ContactDetails.definition: Specifies the options on how to contact the party.

TechnicalAddress.name: Technical Address
TechnicalAddress.definition: Unique technical address to unambiguously identify a party for receiving messages from the executing system.

PartyAddress.name: Party Address
PartyAddress.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

ResidenceType.name: Residence Type
ResidenceType.definition: Specifies the type of residence where the party has its permanent home or principal establishment.

LockStatus.name: Lock Status
LockStatus.definition: Specifies whether the party is locked or not, and the reason for this status, when required.

SystemRestriction.name: System Restriction
SystemRestriction.definition: Defines the specific processing characteristics for a party to ensure configurability of specific requirements, as prescribed by national legal and regulatory requirements and practices.

MarketSpecificAttribute.name: Market Specific Attribute
MarketSpecificAttribute.definition: Additional attributes defined by a central security depositary for a party.
